description.value: Pulled from a flooded ruin along the Drowned Coast, pitted with rust that should have ruined it and somehow didn't touch the mechanism at all. Every confirmed kill leaves a faint, almost musical chime nobody else can hear. Local rumor says it's counting toward something, and nobody's found anyone willing to find out what happens at the total.

cinderfall.incomplete: No stated mechanical effect at all beyond a narrative chime and an explicitly unresolved future consequence ("nobody's found anyone willing to find out what happens at the total") -- reads as an intentional open narrative hook rather than an oversight, but it is a `weapon` item carrying a real `system.rules: []` key (unlike the two true lore-type stubs elsewhere in this class), so it gets a flag like every other zero-number card in this pass rather than being silently skipped.
cinderfall.special: Every confirmed kill leaves a faint chime only the wielder hears, said to be counting toward something. Deliberately unresolved in the fiction; no trigger, total or payoff is authored.
cinderfall.failureRange: no Failure Range (Old World -- ironsight.html:122, 'Old World (Legendary) never fails')
cinderfall.priceless: No price by design, not a gap -- an Old World Gun is 'always found, never bought outright' (ironsight.html:122), matching the corpus's other unique gun (weapon-ranged.the-last-word).
